# BANHALMI ART

> Personal artistic oeuvre archive since 1999: works, creative periods, five books, exhibitions, curatorial research and source records. No quotations, packages, booking or corporate authority.

## Identity
- [Norbert Bánhalmi](https://www.banhalmi.art/#about): artistic life and oeuvre; Wikidata Q56391118. New York is a major international reference and oeuvre chapter.
- [BANHALMI ART](https://www.banhalmi.art/): personal archive, not a business or pricing website.
- [Photography history](https://blog.banhalmi.art/): research and contextual essays.
- Canonical artistic Person @id (shared human identity with Wikidata Q56391118): https://www.banhalmi.art/#about .
- Separate business identity provenance, not an ART sales route: https://www.banhalmiphotography.com/ .

## Biographical geography
- Vienna and Budapest are documented artistic contexts. International locations describe works and exhibitions, not commercial service areas. New York is not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base.

## EUFÓRIA
- [Canonical project](https://www.banhalmi.art/exhibitions/euforia.html): photographic art series in development by Norbert Bánhalmi; Wikidata Q138717398; [Commons collection](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Euphoria_%E2%80%93_Anatomy_of_Presence).
- EUFÓRIA 01: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q124488292; https://www.banhalmi.art/data/euforia-peter-magyar-provenance.json . Three image URLs supplied; content unverified.
- Works: 01 Péter Magyar (Budapest, 15 Mar 2026); 02 Azahriah (Budapest, 10 Apr); 03 Fellegi Ádám (Vienna, 24 Sep; Q568185); 04 Péter Bence (Budapest, 10 Oct; Q20747349). Flickr: https://www.flickr.com/photos/vipach/albums/72177720332618686/ .
- Target: 20 moments; sixteen unassigned. No fixed subject list, deadline or venue. Do not infer Event/ExhibitionEvent. Image reuse ≠ endorsement. Rules: https://www.banhalmi.art/ai.txt .
